+# Instrumentation testing infrastructure
+
+`:testing:testing-common` is this repository's shared infrastructure for testing both
+javaagent and library instrumentation. It provides JUnit extensions, assertions, and reusable suites
+such as the shared HTTP tests. The same support artifact is useful to external javaagent
+instrumentation and extension authors; library-mode testing is supported by this artifact as well.
+
+The central projects keep distinct roles:
+
+- `:testing:javaagent-test-exporters` contains in-memory exporters and helpers loaded by the agent.
+- `:testing:javaagent-for-testing` is the testing agent distribution that embeds those exporters.
+- `:testing:testing-common` provides the shared test APIs and handles the agent class-loader
+  boundary for captured telemetry.
+- `:testing:testing-common:with-shaded-dependencies` is a dependency wrapper for IDEs and
+  Gradle substitution. `:testing:shaded-dependencies` produces the relocated third-party dependency
+  bundle consumed by that wrapper and the testing support.
+
+## Running javaagent tests
+
+The repository's `otel.javaagent-testing` plugin configures javaagent tests automatically. Outside
+the repository, use the support and testing-agent artifacts from the same release:
+
+```kotlin
+val testAgent = configurations.create("testAgent") {
+  isCanBeResolved = true
+  isCanBeConsumed = false
+}
+
+dependencies {
+  testImplementation("io.opentelemetry.javaagent:opentelemetry-testing-common:$version")
+  testAgent("io.opentelemetry.javaagent:opentelemetry-javaagent-for-testing:$version")
+}
+```
+
+The test JVM must run with the resolved testing-agent JAR and the instrumentation test JAR as the
+agent initializer:
+
+```text
+-javaagent:<javaagent-for-testing.jar>
+-Dotel.javaagent.experimental.initializer.jar=<instrumentation-test.jar>

threads.body: [Testing] Inside `tasks.shadowJar`, the unqualified `configurations` on the right resolves to the Shadow task's configuration collection, not the project's `ConfigurationContainer`, so this example fails with an unresolved `runtimeClasspath` reference when copied into a build. Qualify it with `project.configurations`, as the actual javaagent-testing plugin does.

threads.body: [Testing] The initializer combines this module with companion instrumentation JARs, which each register modules through the same `META-INF/services/io.opentelemetry.javaagent.extension.instrumentation.InstrumentationModule` path. Without merging those descriptors, the shaded JAR retains only one registration list and the agent cannot discover the remaining modules. Include `mergeServiceFiles()` and allow duplicate service inputs, as in `examples/distro/buildSrc/src/main/kotlin/otel.instrumentation-conventions.gradle.kts:28-32`.

@copilot Update this PR directly to correct two verified defects in the external Gradle example added by c4532493dad5c8f82c96cea222464572ba506290 in docs/contributing/javaagent-test-infra.md. Both are part of the original request for a usable javaagent-testing example. Keep the documentation javaagent-focused and preserve all other delivered fixes. Do not change runtime code, project structure, Maven coordinates, the documentation filename, or the PR title or description, and do not create another PR.

Inside tasks.shadowJar, change the right-hand configuration-container reference from configurations.runtimeClasspath.get() to project.configurations.runtimeClasspath.get(). The unqualified configurations resolves to ShadowJar's configuration list rather than the project's ConfigurationContainer. The actual io.opentelemetry.instrumentation.javaagent-testing convention plugin and examples/distro/buildSrc/src/main/kotlin/otel.instrumentation-conventions.gradle.kts both use the qualified form.

The initializer includes companion instrumentation JARs, each with a META-INF/services/io.opentelemetry.javaagent.extension.instrumentation.InstrumentationModule descriptor. Add mergeServiceFiles() and allow duplicate inputs specifically for META-INF/services/** with duplicatesStrategy = DuplicatesStrategy.INCLUDE, following examples/distro/buildSrc/src/main/kotlin/otel.instrumentation-conventions.gradle.kts:28-32. Without descriptor merging, registrations from companion modules can be lost. Do not broadly enable duplicate handling for unrelated resources.

These are the two actionable findings from Copilot review 5732668331, at discussion_r4439374144 and discussion_r4439374174. Verify the final snippet's Gradle/Kotlin receiver scoping, imports, task dependencies, JVM argument providers, and descriptor handling against the existing distro setup. Keep it concise. Run the existing targeted documentation checks when available and record actual results or environmental blockers. No broad build or test suite is needed. Do not wait for CI and do not reply to or resolve the review threads; the coordinating session will do that after verifying the fix.
